'''Zach Mann''' (DeckTech handle '''Greedosalive''')<ref name="dt-24003">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24003 What my step It’s yours I should be watching], DeckTech (Zach "Greedosalive" Mann, 17 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24003/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24003/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009084136/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24003/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Light]] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] list on DeckTech (''What my step It’s yours I should be watching'').
